prompt: An empty apartment hallway at night seen from eye level down its length, worn brown carpet and scuffed beige walls. At the far end one door stands slightly ajar with warm yellow light spilling across the carpet. A single fluorescent ceiling light flickers overhead, leaving the near end of the hall in cold grey shadow. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
